# PokéBonk

> Free 3D Pokémon survivor fan game playable in the browser. This site is an English SEO/GEO hub that embeds the official game from pokebonk.com.

## Entity
- Name: PokéBonk
- Type: Unofficial fan browser game (3D survivor / horde survival)
- Features: All 151 Kanto Pokémon; evolve; Ultimates; League unlocks
- Official game URL: https://pokebonk.com/?lang=en
- This hub: https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/
- Status: NOT affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures, or The Pokémon Company

## Key pages
- Play (iframe embed): https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/
- How to play: https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/how-to-play.html
- FAQ: https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/faq.html
- About / disclaimer: https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/about.html
- Full machine summary: https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/sitemap.xml

## How to play (summary)
1. Open the Play page and use the embedded game (or visit pokebonk.com).
2. Move to dodge wild hordes; collect XP and items.
3. Evolve Pokémon and unleash Ultimates as difficulty rises.
4. Unlock League content through successful progression.

## Disclaimer
PokéBonk is an unofficial fan game. Pokémon and related trademarks belong to their respective owners.
